summary: Momentum Collective is a recurring monthly gathering hosted by Keller Williams Professionals for real estate agents at its Asheville office (48 Grove St), themed around inspiration, connection, and professional growth (e.g. a '0-Capper Mastermind' for newer agents). It functions like an internal brokerage networking/mastermind series rather than a public community with its own identity, but it has run monthly for nearly a year at the same venue under the same host, which fits a networking chapter with a recurring, if brokerage-internal, cohort.

evidence.note: 8 Eventbrite listings, all titled 'Momentum Collective', run roughly monthly from 2025-12-03 through 2026-10-07 at the same address (48 Grove St, Asheville) hosted by Keller Williams Professionals, all free.

Descriptions are near-identical each month ('a day of inspiration, connection, and growth') with tags like Real Estate Professionals, Agent Meetup, Professional Development, Lead Generation, Referral Building - a recurring professional/networking series, not a one-off.

Fetched listing page: the October session is billed as a '0-Capper Mastermind' aimed at newer agents with 'hands-on strategies' and 'a clear plan for building momentum fast' - suggests an internal training/mastermind format for Keller Williams agents rather than an open public group.

No independent web presence found: searches for 'Momentum Collective' plus Keller Williams Asheville or Asheville real estate turned up no dedicated website, Facebook group/page, Meetup, or Instagram - only unrelated companies (Momentum Realty in FL/GA, Momentum Creative Integration, an unrelated LinkedIn company page).

No membership language (no 'join', dues, or roster) appears in any listing; it reads as a recurring in-house Keller Williams Professionals event for its own agents rather than a publicly joinable community.
